catalog_transfer.heading: Import a listing or group
catalog_transfer.description: Upload a JSON file exported from this or another site to re-create a listing or group — with its prices, group memberships, and parent references. Any referenced parent listings and groups must already exist here, and the imported name must not already be in use.
catalog_transfer.no_file: Please select a JSON file to import.
catalog_transfer.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
catalog_transfer.demo_disabled: Catalog import is disabled in demo mode.
